coverage: Supply Chain Management and Enterprise Mobility Services
incomeDefinition: The segment rows include sales to other parts of the group. Those sales are removed from the reported group revenue.
definition: The filing’s segment earnings before tax and the share of earnings from a partly owned business or joint venture. Use the separate group profit after tax for the full-year result.
location: Consolidated financial result rows 1, 6, 9 and 12 and consolidated Segment Information rows 1–2, audited annual column.
notes: Removing ₹13.90 crore of internal sales gives ₹6,999.30 crore of group operating revenue. Group profit after tax was ₹10.57 crore, of which ₹2.29 crore belonged to Mahindra Logistics shareholders. The group recorded a ₹7.36 crore charge before tax for higher employee benefits due after new labour rules.
insight: Handling and moving goods brings in most of the group’s sales. Employee transport is smaller, and it contributed a meaningful share of the reported segment result.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment revenue before internal sales are removed
